title: Dynamic Period Control (DPC)
raw_text:
9/29/26, 9:47 AM
Meter reading results and period consumption are displayed per register.

From the overview display, you can double-click on the net amounts to branch to the display of individual billing documents (for
the period billings or the period-end billing).

You can also simulate invoicing for the entire backbilling and/or period-end billing period using the results of the billing simulation.
To do so, you must first save (upload) the results of the billing simulation.

From the overview of the simulation results, you can execute other simulation runs for the contract. This enables you to change the
period consumption per billing period (for the period billings). In this way, the system can generate several simulated versions
whose results you can then compare.

Dynamic Period Control (DPC)

Use

With dynamic period control (DPC), you can manage correction periods and periodic billing periods. You can generate billing
documents that are based on estimated meter readings. You can use the meter reading functions to estimate the meter reading

results and save them to the database, or you can generate them during billing.

Entering an actual meter reading result at any point triggers dynamic backbilling back to the last actual meter reading result. The
system corrects all billing periods that are based on the estimated meter reading results.
